Our goal at S&A Industrial is to offer a professional, cost effective service to the manufacturing industry. We offer a broad range of services including power distribution, new electrical machine controls, electrical repairs and troubleshooting, custom metal fabrication, pipe fitting, millwright services, equipment relocation, and more. We recently expanded into a larger facility, enabling us to increase our services and support to the industry. We are proud to be a fully certified ISO 9001:2000 company.

Our policy at S&A Industrial is to maintain a strong partnership with our customers and suppliers to achieve total customer satisfaction in terms of quality, price, delivery, service, and installation. S&A Industrial and its members endeavour to use their collective knowledge and innovative ideas to promote growth for our customers. We are committed to our policy and strive to continue to be a fast responding, professional and affordable service company.
